title: A tip calculator
description:
Split a bill with a tip.

```
Bill: 84.50
Tip %: 15
People: 4
Tip: 12.68
Each pays: 24.29
```
hints: `double tip = bill * tipPercent / 100.0;`: dividing by `100.0` keeps the result a `double` even if `tipPercent` is an `int` (lesson 1.03).
`%.2f` rounds to two decimals and `%n` ends the line.
requirements: Read with a `Scanner`: the bill with `nextDouble()`, the others with `nextInt()`.
Zero people prints `Nobody to split with`.
stretch: Round each share up to the next cent with `Math.ceil(share * 100) / 100` and say how much extra the tip becomes.
